entities.name: Vaan
entities.description: A morose blue pixie enslaved by a merger-dragon who gathers warriors to kill it.

entities.name: Zumaki
entities.description: A dragon who enslaved Vaan's people; killed fighting a Mak Fawa.

entities.name: Mak Fawa
entities.description: A Phyrexian engine-dragon that fought Zumaki and merged with it.

entities.name: Merger-dragon
entities.description: A new dragon that rose with an engine body and twisted version of Zumaki's mind.

entities.name: Kula
entities.description: An artifact-hating druid recruited by Vaan.

entities.name: Captain Hask
entities.description: Wielder of the Hand of Righteous Retribution, with his crew recruited by Vaan.

entities.name: Hand of Righteous Retribution
entities.description: A magical sword Vaan thought necessary to kill the dragon.

events.summary: Zumaki is attacked by a Mak Fawa and both dragons are killed; a new merged dragon rises.
events.quote: Zumaki was attacked by a Mak Fawa

events.summary: The new dragon enslaves Vaan's people; only Vaan survives and he places glamours on the dragon.
Vaan, under a geas, gathers a group of warriors to kill his master.
events.quote: he managed to gather together a group of warriors to kill his new master

events.summary: The group suffers heavy losses and the dragon reconstructs itself and reanimates Vaan, making the mission a failure.
events.quote: the dragon reconstructed itself and reanimated Vaan

relations.quote: had enslaved Vaan and his people
potion-master Donner Rus , his apprentice Tania Cayce
